verdict.rationale: Square's Locations API docs say additional locations can be created beyond the account's initial one, which covers the location-creation half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents registering or pairing readers via API: the Terminal API excerpt covers only tip collection at checkout, not device registration. missing for 10: documented API-based reader/device registration or pairing for a new location, an explicit CreateLocation endpoint reference, evidence of an agent or MCP-driven end-to-end provisioning flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new location end-to-end via API — creating the location and registering its readers

citations.quote: Newly created accounts only have this single location, but more locations can be created.
